title: Keep deletion-coverage doc in sync with deletes.py verification behavior
answers: What docs must be updated when changing mark_deletions_verified behavior?
Where is the deletes_job verification gate documented?
body:
Changes to how `mark_deletions_verified` treats the survivor count must be mirrored in docs/internal/clickhouse-deletion-coverage.md: the sweeps-section bullet about `deletes_job` and the "Known gaps" entry. A reviewer (Greptile) flagged the doc contradicting the code when only the code changed.
- The `DeleteConfig.verification_max_execution_time` field description in posthog/dags/deletes.py also encodes the gate/report semantics.
- Tests live in posthog/dags/tests/test_deletes.py (`test_marking_proceeds_when_the_check_does_not_come_back_clean`); end-to-end `delete_verified_at` is asserted in `test_full_job_person_deletes`.
applies: Any change to deletes_job verification/gating semantics
says: Deletion verification documentation contradicts the actual code behavior.
ClickHouse deletion sweeps: what gets verified and how?
Where are the gates that control deletion coverage checking?
